**B2B engine Validation:**

Requirement as outlined on April 3rd:

*Sarah & Marcus – B2B enterprise and SMB clients*

* *Bundles of 200–500 user seats*  
  * *Sarah (enterprise): pays via ACH/procurement engine (e.g., Coupa/SAP) — no integration needed, money drops directly to bank*  
  * *Marcus (SMB): pays via Stripe (credit card)*

**Observation \#1**

**Marcus Use Case (Enterprise for SMB):**

Today what is implemented is correct for Marcs, where leader is using their corporate card to pay for their small team of 10 people where AgentArum admin is going through their initial student/free-account to upgrade them to small (SMB) enterprise account as shown/illustrated by following screen:

![][image1]

And once the above screen is approved, Marcus gets email notification to pay for the team via Stripe using their credit card, and everything works as designed. 

**Sarah Use case (Enterprise):**

 This use is where Sarah’s admin is getting Enterprise account and payment is done through a corporate procurement model, i.e. Sarah’s company will send an AgentArum payment check. So, the approve by AgentArum should upgrade the account to Enterprise without any payment email being sent to Sarah’s admin (not stripe). For MVP we agreed since there isn’t any AgentArum ERP, we simply need to record/track a PO number on the above screen and upgrade the account to Enterprise, no need to send Sarah’s admin any payment email. 

Q1: I don’t see the capability to upgrade Sarah’s account that has a PO path today? **This would be a show stopper**, we need this capability, specially we are playing to bring Joint Development Partners who can validate our products. 

One way to implement this is to add a checkbox “PO” and a required input string box to put a PO number. Once the PO number is entered, the “Assign Plan” button should just upgrade the account to Enterprise without sending any email to collect payment. 

If there is another way to implement it, please run it by us.
